findings.evidence: The diff removes configure_json_logging/configure_console_logging from mcp.server's imports, so tests that monkeypatch brain_v42.mcp.server.<configurer> would now fail (AttributeError or silently not bind) — the gateway needed the configurer-injection workaround for exactly this pattern; check tests

findings.title: Unnecessary type: ignore[attr-defined]
